_comment: The ONE table of e2e flows (run order + report rows; the rows that install without a click run first, before this run's clicks could give the backend an IP match for them), the wrapper's take on the native SDKs' scripts/e2e-flows.json. Each row runs on both platforms from e2e/flows/<platform>/<yaml>.yaml. 'kind': offline (no key, no backend), click (real click; Android stages its lt_click through the fake Play referrer, iOS through Safari + Paste; then the backend install check), problistic (a real click but no token: only the backend's IP match can attribute; the wrapper has no device id API, so the device lookup is not checkable and only the app's install answer is asserted), open (re-engagement on the installed app; no click token, no backend check), reopen (install through the type's link, backend baseline, then the re-engagement open; openCount +1 on allow, unchanged on deny, installCount and earning unchanged), reward (as click, then the reward's events through kickflip://e2e/events and the earning of the contract formula), event (trackEvent with a value). 'slot' is a link slot in e2e/e2e-env.json. 'link_type_matrix': the row also runs once per link type of the run's environment, as <flow>__<type> on that type's link; 'link_type_only': only those rows. 'reward': the reward_links model; an environment without that link skips the row. The Play Store install-referrer flows stay in the private Android SDK repo.
